title: On-device recipe
description: One recipe = one model on one runtime, added to an existing app and verified on named devices. The recipe.json that lives next to each recipe's INTEGRATION guide (see provenance.recipe_origin) is the source of truth; this schema follows its keys. The hub adds id, title, platform, status, question_page and source when it vendors the file into recipes.json. Every number must come from a measurement on a named device with a date; the schema has no field for estimates.

id.description: Hub-added. Stable identifier, also the anchor used by docs and llms.txt.

title.description: Hub-added. One line for index tables.

task.description: The request a developer or an agent would make, in natural language. Example: "Add background removal (person segmentation) to an existing Android app, on the GPU".

status.description: Hub-added. verified = INTEGRATION guide published, verify command run on at least one device row with a date. in_progress = code exists, guide or dated verification pending. planned = entry reserved, nothing to run yet.

question_page.description: Hub-added. Repo-relative path of the question page that leads to this recipe.

source.description: Hub-added. Raw URL of the canonical recipe.json this entry was vendored from. tools/check_drift.py compares the entry against it; absent while the canonical file is not published yet, required once status is verified.

model.description: The exact model file the recipe uses.

hf_repo.description: Hugging Face repo id, e.g. litert-community/ormbg-LiteRT.

license.description: SPDX-style id as written on the card, e.g. apache-2.0.

base_model.description: Upstream model the file was converted from, as a Hugging Face repo id.

script.description: Path of the conversion script inside the canonical repo.

patches.description: Graph changes applied before conversion, one line each. Empty when the model converts as-is.

files.description: Files to copy into the existing app, paths inside the canonical repo.

deps.description: Dependency lines exactly as they go into the build file.

command.description: One command that proves the integration works.

expected.description: What the command prints or asserts when it passes, taken from an actual run.

devices.description: One row per device the verify command was run on. Numbers are from that run.

accelerator.description: cpu, gpu, npu, or the vendor backend name.

gpu_nodes.description: Ops placed on the accelerator over total, e.g. "246/246".

ttft_s.description: LLM time to first token in seconds.

parity.description: Agreement with the reference (correlation or max abs diff) as reported.

source.description: Where the row was published if not measured for this recipe entry, e.g. a README at a commit.

unverified.description: What was not tested, one line each (emulator, other devices, other OS versions).

provenance.description: The five-line attribution block. See docs/provenance.md.

converted_by.description: Handle(s) of whoever converted and verified. No real names.

recipe_origin.description: URL of the canonical INTEGRATION guide.

measurement_report.description: URL of the report the device rows come from.

commit.description: Commit of the canonical repo the numbers were taken at, as repo@sha or a bare sha.

maintainer.description: Where to file an issue when the recipe breaks.
